stories.title: Kent District Library announces featured books for 'On the Same Page' event
stories.summary: KDL's On the Same Page will be held at Calvin University's Van Noord Arena on May 21, 2027. This year's featured authors are Tayari Jones and Susan Orlean.

stories.title: Gas expert calls jump in prices at some Michigan stations 'indefensible'
stories.summary: Despite Michigan gas prices dropping on Monday, some stations are selling gas for a price an expert said he couldn't defend.

stories.title: Kalamazoo police investigating death of 2-year-old girl as suspicious
stories.summary: Authorities said officers found 2-year-old Summer Atchison unresponsive at a home along Bridge Street after getting a call about a child who wasn't breathing.

stories.title: FOX Sports donates $50K to Ferris State activities complex
stories.summary: The new activities center will have indoor practice areas, locker rooms, all-weather training spaces, new concessions and even a FOX Sports Media Room for students.

stories.title: Gerald R. Ford Presidential Express returns for the holidays
stories.summary: The Gerald R. Ford Presidential Express, a tribute to Ford's Michigan legacy, returns to the museum Nov. 27 through Jan. 3, 2027.

stories.title: Walker considers $3.64 million contract that would add 10 license plate readers
stories.summary: In addition to 10 automated license plate readers, this new contract would add two drones and access to AI software that would help officers write police reports.

stories.title: Man charged after car crashes into Kentwood retirement home, killing 87-year-old woman inside
stories.summary: The crash killed an 87-year-old woman and sent an 85-year-old to the hospital with serious injuries.

stories.title: 12-year-old student killed in crash with school bus identified by police
stories.summary: Police have identified the student as 12-year-old Taryn Thomas.

stories.title: Court docs: Man didn't remember crashing into Kentwood retirement home, admitted to driving impaired
stories.summary: When Dquan Hamilton was interviewed by police, he said he had been driving that night but did not remember crashing.

stories.title: Michigan Army National Guard supports wildland firefighting readiness training
stories.summary: Firefighters and partners gathered at Camp Grayling for the 2026 Michigan Northwoods TREX to enhance wildland fire readiness.

stories.title: First snowflakes of the season for some Monday evening
stories.summary: A brief round of snow is expected Monday evening. While little to no accumulation is anticipated, visibility could drop.

stories.title: Van Buren Co. Sheriff's Office searching for drone that lost communication, disappeared during flight
stories.summary: The sheriff's office is asking residents in a rural area of the county to keep an eye out for an orange and black drone.
